title: Member-Supply Ceiling on Pharmacy-Placed Renewals by Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus Tier
content:
*Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus benefit schedule, pharmacy supply.*

The days' supply per fill of a renewal Tailwise Pharmacy places by itself is no more than the member-supply ceiling, which follows the customer's Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus membership — its tier and status on the membership record — and the renewed prescription's count of dispensed fills.

| Membership tier | Status | Dispensed fills of the renewed prescription | Member-supply ceiling |
|---|---|---|---|
| Tailwise Plus Annual or Tailwise Plus Premier Annual | active | 4 or more | the class's maximum days' supply per fill |
| Tailwise Plus Monthly or Pals Rewards VIP | active | 4 or more | the renewed prescription's days' supply per fill plus 15 days, never more than the class maximum |
| any tier | active | fewer than 4 | the renewed prescription's days' supply per fill |
| Pals Rewards Member or Pals Rewards Insider | any | any | the renewed prescription's days' supply per fill |
| any tier | past due, pending downgrade or closed | any | the renewed prescription's days' supply per fill |
| no membership | | | the renewed prescription's days' supply per fill |

## Worked cases (hypothetical; prescription written for 60 days, class maximum 90 days, 6 dispensed fills)

- Tailwise Plus Premier Annual, active: ceiling 90 days.
- Pals Rewards VIP, active: 60 plus 15, ceiling 75 days.
- Tailwise Plus Monthly, past due: ceiling 60 days.
- Same Pals Rewards VIP customer on a prescription written for 80 days: 80 plus 15 is 95, held to the class maximum, 90 days.
